# Frozen S6 F1 lease fixtures

`mqtt/lease-fixtures.json` and `non_mqtt/lease-fixtures.json` are generated by
`tests/tools/generate_s6_lease_fixtures.py`.  Each manifest binds the archived
S5 inputs and S6 provider sequence, enumerates the bounded authorization cases,
and names every pre/post-commit recovery window.  The manifests are committed
inputs; tests regenerate them into two temporary directories and compare bytes.
